categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and edits src/rpc/blockchain.cpp to adjust the verificationprogress output field.
categories.rationale: Fixes conflicting progress reporting between RPCs for background chainstates during assumeutxo sync. While `getblockchaininfo` was previously updated, `getchainstates` continued reporting background verification progress relative to the active network tip rather than the snapshot base block, creating an internal RPC inconsistency that is worthwhile to clean up but deferrable.
